title: RNA-seq of human peripheral blood B helper T-cell subsets
description: Human T-cells that express CXCR5 and/or CCR6 provide help to naive B-cells for IgG production. To understand the molecular pathways that are shared or unique to individual B helper T-cell subsets in human peripheral blood, CD4+IL-7R+CD25-/lo helper T-cells were purified according to the expression of CXCR5, CCR6, CXCR3, CD161 and CCR5 as follows: 1) TFH17(CD161-): CXCR5+CXCR6+CXCR3-CD161-  2) Th17: CXCR5-CCR6+CXCR3-, CD161+ or CCR5+ 3) CCR6”SP”: CXCR5-CCR6+CXCR3-CD161-CCR5- RNA-seq was performed with FACS-purified T-cell subsets from 3 healthy individuals.

samples.title: SQ_2051
samples.description: Protocols: Peripheral blood mononuclear cells were magnetically enriched for CD4+ T-cells with a kit (Miltenyi). T-cells were stained with antibodies to CD4, Il-7R, CD25, CXCR5, CCR6, CXCR3, CD161 and CCR5 and purified on a FACS Aria (BD). CD4+IL-7R+CD25-/lo helper T-cells were purified as CXCR5+CCR6+CXCR3-CD161-CCR5- TFH17-cells, CXCR5-CCR6+CXCR3-CD161+ or CCR5+Th17-cells or as CXCR5-CCR6+CXCR3-CD161-CCR5-CCR6SP T-cells RNA was isolated using mirVana Isolation Kit (ThermoFisher) Library construction was performed with the TruSeq RNA Sample Preparation Kit v2 (Illumina)
